moment.text: In 1835, Hiroshige was involved in publishing the Sixty-nine Stations of the Kiso Road, comprising seventy prints.

matters.text: These prints of the mountainous Kisokaidō offered urban print collectors views of scenic spots without the inconveniences of travel.
